recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, text-driven composition featuring a large numeric display in the lower half and a small metadata line at the top, set against a solid, warm peach background.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme scale contrast between the large central numbers and the small top text
Strict vertical alignment along the center axis
High-contrast black typography against a muted pastel background
Generous negative space in the upper two-thirds of the frame
coreInvariants: Horizontal rule separating top text from the void

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large numeric characters dominate the bottom third of the frame, spanning nearly the full width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central colon and flanking numbers act as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the small top text, follows the vertical axis down through the negative space, and rests on the large numbers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive open space in the middle section creates a sense of importance and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Peach/Apricot background providing a warm, flat canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for all typographic elements and graphic lines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: None; the design relies on binary color contrast.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background with high-value contrast against the black foreground.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Colon consists of two perfectly circular dots
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monotype pairing using different scales and weights of a similar serif family.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal line (rule) centered below the top text

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and sharp serifs match the display numbers.
Classic high-contrast serif with strong verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid, flat peach-colored square canvas with no texture or gradients.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small line of all-caps serif text at the top center. Below it, add a thin black horizontal line. In the bottom third, place large, bold serif numbers separated by a colon, centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid peach color?
Is the large text positioned in the bottom third?
Is there a thin horizontal line below the top text?
Are all elements perfectly centered horizontally?

mustRedesign: Specific album titles or artist-specific identifiers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no artifacts in the solid background
Check that the colon dots are circular
Verify the horizontal rule is perfectly straight
Confirm the scale ratio between top and bottom text is at least 1:10
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Pastel Background + Top Metadata + Horizontal Rule + Large Bottom-Weighted Serif Typography = Minimalist Editorial Cover
